events.question: How many feature-usage events did our Los Angeles–timezone customers have in Q3 2026, using their local time?

plan.headline: Counts feature_used events from non-test organizations in the America/Los_Angeles timezone during Q3 2026, bucketed by each org's local calendar dates.

metrics.title: Feature-usage events (LA customers)
metrics.description: Total number of events with type 'feature_used' from organizations whose home timezone is America/Los_Angeles, occurring within the selected date range, with date boundaries evaluated in the chosen timezone.

metrics.title: Feature-usage events per week
metrics.description: Weekly count of feature_used events from Los Angeles-timezone organizations across the selected date range, with weeks starting on Monday in the chosen timezone.

assumptions.label: Date range
assumptions.rationale: Question asks for Q3 2026, which is July 1 through September 30 inclusive.

assumptions.label: Reporting timezone
assumptions.rationale: You asked for local time for Los Angeles customers, so day boundaries use America/Los_Angeles.

assumptions.label: Customer timezone
assumptions.rationale: Customers are selected by organizations.timezone, their home timezone; this is the value matched exactly.

assumptions.label: Exclude test orgs
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says test tenants (QA, demo, load-test) should be excluded from business metrics.

assumptions.label: Exclude internal users
assumptions.rationale: Events from our own staff (users.is_internal) are not customer usage, so they are excluded by default.

events.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM northwind.events e JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = e.org_id JOIN northwind.users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE e.type = 'feature_used' AND o.timezone = :customer_timezone::text AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false) AND (NOT :exclude_internal_users::boolean OR u.is_internal = false) AND e.occurred_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND e.occurred_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
events.explanation: Counts feature_used events for orgs in the chosen customer timezone, excluding test orgs and internal users, within the date range boundaries in the reporting timezone.

events.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT e.id, date_trunc('week', e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)::date AS week_start
  FROM northwind.events e
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = e.org_id
  JOIN northwind.users u ON u.id = e.user_id
  WHERE e.type = 'feature_used'
    AND o.timezone = :customer_timezone::text
    AND e.occurred_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND e.occurred_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    AND (NOT :exclude_internal_users::boolean OR u.is_internal = false)
)
SELECT week_start AS x, count(*)::int AS y
FROM filtered
GROUP BY week_start
ORDER BY week_start
events.explanation: Counts feature_used events from orgs matching the customer timezone (excluding test orgs and internal users per flags) in the date range, grouped by Monday-start week in the reporting timezone.
